absent_P1_fields.note: Absent is not a fabricated false/zero default. HitTypeName, DamageType, CollisionCountMax and TimeBetweenHits are separate actual P1 fields.

shared_victim_receipts.owner: The MotherCore owns proto::CollisionActionBehaviour. Both non-thrown Hit actions share this owner component, rather than independent per-track victim sets.
shared_victim_receipts.bind: 100a4310 binds action owner to action+20, then cat 0x1d/subtype 7 queries CollisionActionBehaviour into action+24. Handler 10064b60 returns the component. UseOriginatorToValidate=false leaves owner selection unchanged.
shared_victim_receipts.enable: 100aa830 is !(track+11c bit 1), i.e. !IsThrown. Both tracks serialize IsThrown=false.
shared_victim_receipts.active_scope: 100a4970 entry calls 10065470(true), incrementing component+c active count; 100a3780 exit calls 10065470(false). The component list is cleared when there are no active actions.
shared_victim_receipts.candidate_validation: 100a3810 rejects the source object and applies native receiver checks before 100654c0 checks the shared handle receipt. Additional target eligibility is not a Minecraft faction predicate.
shared_victim_receipts.repeat: 100654c0 permits an already-recorded handle only when TimeBetweenHits>=0 and its elapsed time reaches that interval. Both tracks serialize -1, so the same live receipt rejects repeats.
shared_victim_receipts.mark_timing: 10065940 records or resets the handle BEFORE the action dispatches the damage/reaction message. Swept path: 100a500f..100a503a mark, 100a504a count, 100a508c dispatch. Overlap path: 100a55b0..100a55e2 mark, 100a5605 count, 100a5627 dispatch.
shared_victim_receipts.rejection_boundary: Once a candidate passes the native query and pre-hit validators and is marked, subsequent damage/reaction no-op or receiver refusal does not condition that mark on a successful hurt return. Earlier query/validator rejection does not reach mark. No Minecraft-style cancellation hook exists in this proven native layer; a future adapter must explicitly document whether its cancellation occurs before or after the source-equivalent receipt boundary.
shared_victim_receipts.expiry: 10065a80 increases each entry elapsed time by dt and removes it only when elapsed > 5.0 seconds (10d9486c); activeCount<=0 clears the list. Both emergence tracks finish before this 5-second expiry.
shared_victim_receipts.overlap_implication: R3 begins at 0 and can consume a victim before R20 begins at 0.33333298563957214. During overlap, whichever action/candidate is processed first may suppress the other. Do not replace this with independent hit windows or Goliath strongest-window merging.
shared_victim_receipts.ordering_status: Stable authored track order in the same initial ActionList. R20 (FIG41324) is processed before R3 (FIG41776) whenever both are active; activation time does not move an action to the tail or re-sort it. 1090bde0 handles engine phase4. At 1090be2b..38 it calls poll(1), then finalization. After conditional node selection, 1090bea1..b6 calls advance(2, dt), then poll(0). CollisionHitAction enter 100a4970 at 100a4977..100a498a enables 0x800 << (entryPhase-1). Mother enters with phase2, so its collision tick is poll1. A newly activated Hit is not ticked by the immediately following poll0; it first ticks on the following mother update poll1.

The normal source MotherCore path resolves this missing name to 0xffff and R3 sweeps actor/root translation. Missing Neck_1 resolves to root. The sphere has local center0 and radius3. spatial_and_shapecast.scale_boundary: 10634850 ->106347b0 ->10645980(type2 jump-table entry10645999) ->106446d0 transforms local sphere center by the supplied matrix, reads unchanged radius+3c, and writes center +/- that radius. It never writes radius or multiplies it by matrix scale. The separate10644820 scale operation is not on this path. R20 constructs an AABB from the local sphere, transforms that broadphase AABB by current root matrix in100a2650, and then asks each enabled target primitive for closest surface relative to current root translation. 100a5438..100a5447 compares its distance against raw action+98 radius20. damage_and_impulse.base: 100a9819..100a983b interpolates min/max damage. Since each track has equal min/max, base damage is 800 (R20) or 100 (R3), before the enabled transformation and conditional friendliness multipliers.
damage_and_impulse.multipliers: 100a9919..100a9964 sends category 0x1e/subtype 0xc for the enabled transformation multiplier. Weapon multiplier path 100a9970..100a99bb is disabled by both tracks.

damage_and_impulse.R20_impulse: [0,10000,-5000] therefore points upward and radially outward for the ordinary root-to-root reference.
damage_and_impulse.R3_impulse: [2000,5000,2000] retains authored lateral/back components after that rotation. It must not be replaced by a generic outward knockback vector.

action_order_and_clock.result: Stable authored track order in the same initial ActionList. R20 (FIG41324) is processed before R3 (FIG41776) whenever both are active; activation time does not move an action to the tail or re-sort it.
action_order_and_clock.track_loading: 10a83240 calls 10a83130 with insertion index -1. For an initially empty track group, 10a83130 reads successive tracks and links previous+4 to the next newly read track (10a831ea..10a8320f), preserving reader/file order. This is not a claim that every later nonempty-group insertion is append-only.
action_order_and_clock.creation: Node main-list construction 10a85d20 passes node+30 to 10a834d0. That function walks Track.next at +4 and calls 10a850b0 in order. 10a850b0 invokes the track factory through 10a850a0/vslot15, adds BeginTime and EndTime-BeginTime, then calls 10a7f6c0.
action_order_and_clock.append: 10a7f6c0 adds current list clock to action begin, links the previous tail.next at +8 to the new action using 10a7da60, and updates tail at list+40. Head is list+3c. There is no BeginTime or damage sorting.
action_order_and_clock.activation: 10a7fc20 advances list clock (+38) by dt*speed, then walks head+3c and action.next+8. It activates an inactive action when clock>=action.begin (+10), sets active bit4, and stores pendingDelta=clock-begin in action+18. Already activated actions receive this advance dt in +18. All eligible actions on one advance retain list order.
action_order_and_clock.poll: 10a7f7b0 walks the same head/next chain, calling only active, not-ended actions whose phase bit is enabled. It completes one action update before moving to the next action; candidate processing of R20 and R3 is not interleaved.
action_order_and_clock.mother_tick_phases: 1090bde0 handles engine phase4. At 1090be2b..38 it calls poll(1), then finalization. After conditional node selection, 1090bea1..b6 calls advance(2, dt), then poll(0).
action_order_and_clock.hit_phase_registration: CollisionHitAction enter 100a4970 at 100a4977..100a498a enables 0x800 << (entryPhase-1). Mother enters with phase2, so its collision tick is poll1. A newly activated Hit is not ticked by the immediately following poll0; it first ticks on the following mother update poll1.
action_order_and_clock.shared_receipt_implication: R3 can mark a target before R20 starts. During overlap, an unrecorded target reached by both is offered to R20 first. An R3 receipt from an earlier update suppresses R20. Preserve the shared owner ledger; never merge overlapping windows by strongest damage.

action_clock_boundaries.native_start: 10a7fcd1..10a7fcda skips only when clock<begin. Equality activates.
action_clock_boundaries.native_stop: Finalizer 10a7fe7a..10a7feb3 subtracts action.pendingDelta from remainingDuration after poll1. It ends only when the new remainingDuration<0; equality is retained. Initially negative duration is the unbounded sentinel, but these Hit durations are positive.
action_clock_boundaries.duration_initialization: 10a7d8e0 initializes action+10,+14,+18 to zero. 10a850b0 adds track begin to +10 and track duration (1014bf90=end-begin) to +14. On first activation pendingDelta=clock-begin; subsequent advances write dt*speed.
action_clock_boundaries.clock_at_collision: The collision callback uses the previous advance pendingDelta and the pre-current-advance ActionList clock. The callback is invoked before checking expiration; duration is not an absolute EndTime check at the top of collision update.
action_clock_boundaries.20Hz_reference_convention: If the MC adapter deliberately activates the t0 track at age0, uses speed1 and advances nominal clock by .05 seconds per age, R3 first collision is age1; R20 activates at age7 and first collision is age8. This age convention is an MC choice, not a native 20Hz engine claim.
action_clock_boundaries.20Hz_R3_end: Under that convention R3 End=2.9333300590515137 produces a final callback at age60: after age59 finalization about .03333 seconds remain, then age60 polls before subtracting another .05 and expiring. Stopping at age59 by floor(end*20) would omit the source phase ordering.
action_clock_boundaries.20Hz_R20_end_boundary: Under exact-real .05 arithmetic, age21 polls then reaches remaining==0 and is retained, so age22 is the final poll before a negative remainder. Native float accumulation/subtraction can move the zero boundary to a small negative value and expire at age21 instead. No fixed 21-versus-22 claim is made without fixing the MC numeric clock policy; original dt is variable and this audit did not execute a clock simulation.
action_clock_boundaries.implementation_advice: Use a small ordered state machine with active/end flags, pendingDelta and remainingDuration: poll existing hits in authored order; subtract their pendingDelta and end on <0; then advance the shared clock and activate eligible tracks. Do not express this as age in [ceil(begin*20),floor(end*20)]. Choose and document float versus an integer/rational MC timing policy and verify its boundary cases later.
